items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: And people call you Mealy, though, huh? / Oh, I call me Mealy for a short name.

ctx.x: And people call you Mealy, though, huh?
Oh, I call me Mealy for a short name. How do you spell Mealy? Well, really, I couldn't tell you to spell it so many different names.
